name: Peac Institute of Multiscale Science
zh: 顶峰多尺度科学研究所
supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list names the Peac Institute of Multiscale Science among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP) as well as in an entry of its own, and the US Commerce Department listed it in 2020, at an address in Chengdu, as one of ten entities owned by, operated by or directly affiliated with CAEP, the complex responsible for researching, developing and testing China’s nuclear weapons.

sources.title: Named Research Organizations (entries for the Peac Institute of Multiscale Science and for the Chinese Academy of Engineering Physics and its known aliases; page modified 2024-04-18)

sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)

history.change: Record created to cover both NRO entries for this institute: its own entry and the CAEP alias that the NRO data splits out.
